nodes.description: Immutable IFree interface reference set in the constructor; target of external mint/ownerOf/appendAttributeToToken calls.
Public mapping(address => Stake) holding per-staker staking records including totalStaked and mintBlockNumber.
Public mapping(uint256 => bool) tracking whether a Free0 token has already been consumed for a Free3 mint.
Address with administrative privileges; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated by transferAdministratorship.
Immutable minimum number of blocks that must elapse before a second stake or a claim is allowed.
Immutable upper bound of the block window for secondStake/claim and the deadline used by withdraw.
Constructor setting free, stakePeriod, progressPeriodExpiration and administrator from msg.sender.
Admin-only function that reassigns the administrator address.
Payable first stake entry point; records block number and accumulates msg.value into totalStaked.
Payable second stake; enforces a block-number window derived from stakePeriod/progressPeriodExpiration.
Admin-only refund of a failed stake; transfers totalStaked to the administrator.
Free0 holder claims a Free3: validates ownership/time window, marks usage, mints via free and refunds stake.
Caller-controlled address used for staking identity, admin checks, ownership checks and ETH refund destinations.
payable(administrator).transfer(stake.totalStaked) in withdraw; external ETH send.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(stake.totalStaked) in claim; external ETH send to caller after external calls.

External call free.appendAttributeToToken(free0TokenId, 'Used For Free3 Mint', 'true') into IFree.
Arithmetic accumulation stake.totalStaked += msg.value in firstStake/secondStake.
